opening.argument: The video promotes The Fortune Miner through unusually high BNB-return claims and a participation structure built around deposits, compounding, withdrawals, and redeposits. The speaker says, "It prints up to 3.33% daily in BNB. You get a 1% daily compound bonus up to 10%." He describes staking and his own 2.23 BNB deposit, while the dashboard displays deposit, withdrawal, yield, and compounding controls. Participation also carries a stated 90% tax unless users compound first, and the system offers a referral bonus. Most significantly, the speaker acknowledges that "it's going to start as a Ponzi" while revenue sources develop. High-risk and no-guarantee disclaimers do not undo the promotion's return claims and incentives.
